name: B10-0107/2025 (The Left) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on Georgia's political situation. It does not change any law. It calls on Georgia's government to keep its reform promises and stay on the path to joining the European Union. It asks the European Union to keep talking with Georgia and to keep the visa deal in place. It criticises two new Georgian laws, one on "foreign influence" and one on "family values", and it raises concerns about force used against protesters.

- The text asks for dialogue and reform; it changes no law itself.
- It concerns Georgia's government, its people, and European Union institutions.
- Next, the text is sent to European Union bodies and to Georgia's president, government and parliament.
